result.instructions: Tools for Inventory Planner, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are about to run out of stock soon?"; "Show my open purchase orders and their expected dates."; "Which suppliers can I order the variant SKU TSHIRT-M from?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Inventory Planner data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run inventoryplanner_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run inventoryplanner_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run inventoryplanner_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. inventoryplanner_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_list_variants
tools.title: List variants (forecast and replenishment)
tools.description: List product variants with Inventory Planner's computed metrics (forecast, replenishment, days to sell out, lost revenue, lead time, review period and ~200 more). Always pass `fields` to pick the metrics you need (default: id,sku,lead_time,review_period,replenishment,oos,under_value; oos = forecasted days to sell out, under_value = forecasted lost revenue, replenishment = recommended order quantity). Use `filters` and `sort` for questions like "which SKUs need reordering". Removed variants are excluded unless include_removed. GET /api/v1/variants.

filters.description: Filters, as {"<field>": value} or {"<field>_<operator>": value}. Operators: eq (default), eqi (case-insensitive), ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, range ("5-10"), match (regex), in (comma-separated). Example: {"replenishment_gt": 0, "sku_match": "^TSHIRT"}.

page.description: Page number, counting from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_get_variant
tools.title: Get variant
tools.description: One variant by its Inventory Planner id, with the metrics named in `fields` (default: id,sku,lead_time,review_period,replenishment,oos,under_value). GET /api/v1/variants/{id}.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_list_variant_vendors
tools.title: List a variant's vendors
tools.description: The vendors a variant can be ordered from, with cost_price, landing_cost_price, vendor_reference (vendor SKU), vendor_name, vendor_packaging (MOQ) and uom_ordering. GET /api/v1/variants/{id}/vendors.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_get_variant_vendor
tools.title: Get a variant's vendor terms
tools.description: One vendor's terms for a variant: cost_price, landing_cost_price, vendor_reference, vendor_name, vendor_packaging (MOQ), uom_ordering. vendor_id is the vendor name in lowercase. GET /api/v1/variants/{id}/vendors/{vendor_id}.

vendor_id.description: The vendor name in lowercase, as listed by inventoryplanner_list_variant_vendors.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders (and transfers, assembly orders)
tools.description: List stock orders: purchase orders, transfers and assembly orders (the `type` field is "po"/empty, "transfer" or "assembly"). Filter with `filters`, e.g. {"status": "OPEN", "vendor": "Acme", "expected_date_lt": "2026-11-01"}. Default fields: id,reference,status,type,vendor,warehouse,source,created_date,expected_date,received_date,currency,total,total_ordered,total_received. GET /api/v1/purchase-orders.

filters.description: Filters, as {"<field>": value} or {"<field>_<operator>": value}. Operators: eq (default), eqi (case-insensitive), ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, range ("5-10"), match (regex), in (comma-separated). Example: {"replenishment_gt": 0, "sku_match": "^TSHIRT"}.

page.description: Page number, counting from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get purchase order
tools.description: One purchase order, transfer or assembly order by id, with its header fields (reference, status, vendor, warehouse, dates, addresses, totals, notes) and line items. GET /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_list_purchase_order_items
tools.title: List purchase order line items
tools.description: The line items of a purchase order: variant id, sku, title, ordered quantity (replenishment), received quantity and received_history, cost price, tax, discount and stock snapshots. GET /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}/items.

page.description: Page number, counting from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_get_purchase_order_connections
tools.title: Get purchase order connection status
tools.description: Whether and how a purchase order was saved to connected systems (ERP, accounting): per connection the status (success, error, run, queued), save_po flag and the PO's id and reference there. Read-only. GET /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}/connections.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_get_purchase_order_stock_update
tools.title: Get purchase order stock update (preview)
tools.description: The stock updates a purchase order has computed: per warehouse (wh) the items with stock_before, delta and error. for_destination false reads the source warehouse of a transfer. Read-only: nothing is pushed. GET /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}/stock-update.

for_destination.description: true (default) = the destination warehouse; false = the source warehouse (transfers only).

tools.name: inventoryplanner_create_draft_purchase_order
tools.title: Create a draft purchase order
tools.description: WRITE: create a purchase order with status "draft" in Inventory Planner (POST /api/v1/purchase-orders). A draft is only a plan inside Inventory Planner: it is NOT sent to the vendor, NOT saved to any connected system and moves no stock or money. Purchase orders only (no transfers or assembly orders). Each line item is a variant id plus the quantity to order (replenishment).

vendor.description: The vendor name, as it appears in Inventory Planner.

warehouse.description: The destination warehouse, as it appears in Inventory Planner.

tools.name: inventoryplanner_update_draft_purchase_order
tools.title: Edit a draft purchase order
tools.description: WRITE: change the reference, expected date or notes of a purchase order that is still a draft (PATCH /api/v1/purchase-orders/{id}). The order is read first and refused unless its status is "draft". It never changes the status, sends the order, or touches line items or received quantities.
